doc.name: VORAGO
doc.title: THE STAR THAT DRINKS
doc.blurb: Cygnus X-1, the first one found: a shadow the colour of the sky inside a photon ring, an accretion disc scrolling cream to ember with the left half brighter (Doppler beaming), and one arm of seven stars falling in, the last two drawn out to streaks as the tide takes them. The true owner of the blackout curse; the attack a jet.
doc.where: SS_ACTS[2].bosses @257: append 'vorago' (Act III boss, the owner of the blackout curse; Wyatt confirms). The eye sits on the photon ring's bright left side (Doppler beaming), so lash/breath/volley read the jet's root, not the shadow.
